scope: Synthetic PostgreSQL 17-compatible Caregiving data contract, RLS isolation, three-recipient workflow, UI contract and Coaching RPC reproducibility.

results.name: Migration creates private recipient and record tables
One caregiver can maintain at least three separate profiles
Appointments, medications, notes, routines and contacts stay attached to their profiles
A consolidated overview can query every owned profile and open item
A different signed-in user cannot read another caregiver records
Cross-account record attachment is blocked by RLS and owned foreign key
Recipient deletion cascades only that recipient records
Frontend exposes the six required Caregiving views and no local sensitive-data fallback
Coaching dashboard RPC is recorded with explicit least-privilege execution
Coaching dashboard RPC installs and returns a safe empty workspace for a new coach
